content:
**Picklock Expert** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

In *Fallout 76*, locked doors and containers require a lockpicking skill ranging from 0 to 3 to attempt lockpicking. When equipped, Picklock Expert increases this skill by 1, as well as increases the range of the "sweet spot" by 10%.

When equipped with one of the other two lockpicking perk cards, Picklock and Picklock Master, player characters can attempt to lockpick skill level 2 locks.

With all three perk cards equipped, player characters can attempt to lockpick skill level 3 locks. Duplicate perk cards cannot be equipped to increase the lockpicking skill.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain +1 lockpicking skill, and the lockpicking 'sweet spot' is 10% larger. | 00052400 |
